A '''raid''' was carried out on the planet [[Comkin V]] during the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]/[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] collaboration against [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]]. Comkin V returned under Imperial control after the battle.<ref name="TEA" />
